Path: business objects and records — a declared form option takes effect | 缺项 (`object-form`'s `modalCloseButton` is never read) | P3

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue`. Direction: enforce. `ModalForm` reads the key

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx` (declares `modalCloseButton`, never reads it) ⇒ `domain:ui`.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-09-29T09:13Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**Why p3.** A declared, forwarded key has no effect: `modalCloseButton: false` still shows the close button. That is ADR-0049's shape on a minor presentation option.

**Direction: enforce, by the maintainer's criterion on #18900.** Mainstream modal forms let an author hide the close button, so the consumer is built, not the key retired. `ModalForm` hides the dialog's close button when `modalCloseButton === false`. When hidden, the form must keep another way to dismiss it (Cancel, or Escape). **Pins:** `false` hides it, the default shows it, and the dialog can still be dismissed. Restore the registration description's 「honoured by ModalForm」 once it is true.

- `packages/plugin-form/src/index.tsx:274`: the registration description is restored to 「honoured by ModalForm」 once that is true.
- Pins: `false` hides the button, the default shows it, and the dialog can still be dismissed. One changeset (`'@object-ui/plugin-form': patch`).

⛔ No change to the key's type or schema (`packages/types`), and no second close affordance invented.
Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (TIER_DEFAULT; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over this surface: no path-derived mandate, at objectstack `288611e3`)
Clause-②: no
Why no: a declared and forwarded key starts taking effect (ADR-0049 declared ⇒ enforced); no type, schema, export or published accept set moves.

Seat answer to the dev's open question (report `5889134591`), and claim amendment (`5888697196`) · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec` · 2026-09-29T11:17Z

The route is the seat's, not the decision box's. It is inside triage's enforce ruling (`5887233605`) and moves no product semantics.

**Route A: the switch goes on the shared dialog wrapper.** `packages/components/src/custom/mobile-dialog-content.tsx` (`MobileDialogContent`) gains an optional boolean `showCloseButton`, default `true`. `ModalForm` passes `schema.modalCloseButton !== false` on both of its dialog arms.

Why not the other options:
- **B (a CSS hide)** couples `plugin-form` to another package's DOM. Its only pin would assert a class string, so it could never fail: a masked no-op.
- **C (a forked dialog shell)** duplicates the wrapper's mobile chrome and adds a runtime dependency.
- **D (retire the key)** contradicts triage's enforce direction.

AGENTS.md #7 routes dialog behaviour to the `custom/` wrapper. The seat measured at objectui `origin/main` `a5841be35`: `ModalForm.tsx` is the wrapper's only in-tree consumer outside its own tests. The default keeps every other consumer's button.

**Claim amendment** (surface, and `Clause-②`):
- **File surface += `packages/components/src/custom/mobile-dialog-content.tsx`** and its tests under `packages/components/src/__tests__/` (the existing `mobile-dialog-content*` / `mobile-dialog-close-*` files, or one new pin).
- **Pins:**
  - the wrapper's default still renders the close button;
  - `showCloseButton={false}` removes it from the DOM (a real `getByRole` absence);
  - `ModalForm` with `modalCloseButton: false` has no close button, and Escape and Cancel still reach `onOpenChange(false)`;
  - the default `ModalForm` keeps it.
- **`Clause-②: yes`** (was `no`). `packages/components/src/custom/index.ts` re-exports the wrapper with `export *`, so its published props type widens by one optional member. The changeset is `@object-ui/components: minor` and `@object-ui/plugin-form: patch`. A contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` runs before landing.
- **Serial:** by their three-dot diffs, none of the in-flight branches of objectui#11026, #10993 batch 2, #11067, #11060 and seat 1's #11062 touches `packages/components/src/custom/` or `plugin-form`. Neither do open PRs objectui#11069 and #10278, by their file lists.

The rest of the claim stands. ⛔ No change to the key's type or schema in `packages/types`.
